## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? A clear and concise description of the need, e.g. "I can't ..." or "It is hard to ...".

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see, including any API shape you have in mind (new renderer option, parser format, exporter, etc.).

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, and any workarounds you currently use.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps: sample profiler output, screenshots, links to related formats or tools.
